newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Joint venture between MCI, Telefonica - P.Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Joint venture between MCI, Telefonica - P.Telecom.

text.p: The U.S. MCI and Telefonica Internacional, an international arm of Spain's Telefonica, have formed a Pan American joint venture, Portugal Telecom said on Monday.

In a statement announcing its own alliance with the British Telecom -MCI venture, Concert, Telecom said that this alliance would work together in Latin America through the "Pan American joint venture announced today by MCI and Telefonica Internacional."
The statement gave no further details and no announcement has yet been made by MCI or Telefonica.
The Spanish company had been in talks with a number of companies about seeking a U.S. partner and press reports had widely tipped MCI.
